notes.title: Character Customization Update
notes.content:
This update introduces the feature to dress up John Harry any way you want! Grow a full beard, put on an aviator hat, a pink cat shirt or some plain old regular glasses! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34907587/eeeb6e93a571d6d0e9bb3f7278612680d3b6064a.gif[/img]

There's one caveat: you have to pay for your clothes/beards/hair/glasses/hats with booze. Yes, the same precious booze you also drink to get your health back. 

So now it's [i]a choice between survival and looking pretty[/i].

This is all the stuff you can buy:
[list]
[*]6 beards, moustaches and a clean shaven face
[*]5 hairstyles (if you count a bald head as a hairstyle)
[*]6 completely new clothes (although some may have been worn before)
[*]2 never seen before glasses
[*]4 hats (HATS!)
[/list]

[previewyoutube=aN8fQuF_zc4;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: December 2019 patch
notes.content:
This patch will fix the following things:

[list]
[*] Lots of typos
[*] The broken "No guns!" achievement
[*] The broken "They're all dead!" achievement
[*] The description of that same achievement to clarify the scientists need to die in the lab
[*] A bottle of gin that was mislabeled as peach liqueur
[*] The cave exit near the church that showed daylight in the night
[*] Crashing the game when trying to access your inventory in a cut scene in the lab
[*] The mention of your gun in dialogues after you refused the gun
[*] The exploit in the roman numeral room
[*] Going back from the controls tab in the menu making you unable to select anything
[/list]

Thanks to Drєэm for bringing all this stuff to my attention! 

And also thanks to myself for creating these problems. Good job!

notes.title: November 2019 patch
notes.content:
Some stuff that was broken is now less broken or even NOT BROKEN AT ALL! How about that!

I also wanted to let you guys now that the person responsible for all these bugs and mistakes has been given a raise and has also been promoted, because I think imcompetence is severely underrated in todays society and should be rewarded at every opportunity.

[b]Patch notes[/b]
[list]
[*] Game doesn't crash anymore when returning to "desert" room
[*] You're able to pick up items again after loading a quick save
[*] You can't drop items on certain locations anymore, in order to prevent conflicts with trying to operate stuff like the computer, etc.
[*] Dropped (base) cocktails don't turn into mugs anymore when you leave the room
[*] Fixed broken running animation in cutscene in the old farm
[*] Fixed cutscene sometimes not being triggered in cave where you find sewer key
[*] Masks are visible again on ladders in the lab
[*] Corrected quite a few typos and spelling mistakes
[*] Other minor stuff
[/list]

notes.title: Prologue and Performance Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34907587/3ebcfe508acc5e9f957c135c0ea9156d7141a783.png[/img]
Another update! But what makes this update special? Let's see:

[list]
[*] The prologue has been added as an extra to the main game* 
[*] A major performance update has been implemented, meaning performance has increased about two to three times
[*] Minor bugfixing and stuff (not so special)
[/list]

[b]About the Prologue[/b]

In the prologue you play as Randy (the car mechanic who has disappeared in the main game). Randy has a bad dream, there is someone in his bedroom and on top of that they want him to make more moonshine. What a day!

* The prologue was already available as the demo, but seeing as you can't play the demo on Steam once you've bought the game it seemed like a good idea to add it to the main game. (Which somehow wasn't as easy as it sounds!) So there!

tags.feature: The prologue has been added as an extra to the main game*
A major performance update has been implemented, meaning performance has increased about two to three times

tags.bug: Minor bugfixing and stuff (not so special)

notes.title: Patch 1.0.0.4: new achievements
notes.content:
Patch 1.0.0.4

Aside from fixing a few bugs and spelling mistakes, there are a few other changes of things that people suggested/requested, namely:

[list]

[*] The addition of two achievements ("Now that's a workout!" and "Footsteps on the ceiling" - both for ordeals in the old hotel)
[*] A few extra cues relating to the choices which will decide which ending you get
[*] It is now possible to complete the meditation ordeal in the old hotel (initially it wasn't supposed to be solvable)
[/list]
